quotes.title: HD 85628
quotes.card: HD 85628 (MASCARA-4) is a binary star system in the constellation of Carina.
quotes.introduction: The host star, HD 85628 A, is an A-type main-sequence star, the primary star of the system, with a hot Jupiter in orbit around it.
